/pages/refund-return-policy-1.title: Refund & Return Policy | JIYU Korean Skin Care
/pages/refund-return-policy-1.html:
Refund & Return Policy

Effective Date: 5 January 2026

We want you to love your JIYU Skincare products! If something’s not right, here’s how we can help.

1. 90-Day Satisfaction Guarantee

We want you to feel confident trying JIYU. That's why every purchase is backed by our 90-Day Satisfaction Guarantee.
If you're not satisfied with your JIYU products for any reason, you can contact us within 90 days of your purchase to request a full refund.
No product return is required. We believe skincare is personal, and we don't want you to worry about sending back products you've already opened or used.
To request a refund, email support@jiyuskin.com with:

Your order number
The product(s) you're requesting a refund for
A brief explanation of your experience
Our team will review your request and, once approved, process your refund to your original payment method.

2. Refund Processing

Once your refund is approved, please allow 5–10 business days for the refund to appear on your original payment method. Processing times may vary depending on your bank or payment provider.
Original shipping costs are non-refundable.

3. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Orders

If your order arrives damaged, defective, or contains the wrong product, please contact us within 7 days of delivery at support@jiyuskin.com.
Please include:

Your order number
Photos of the damaged or incorrect item
A brief description of the issue
We'll work quickly to make it right with a replacement or refund.

4. Do I Need to Return My Products?

No.
JIYU does not require customers to return products to receive a refund under our 90-Day Satisfaction Guarantee.
For safety and hygiene reasons, we do not accept physical returns of skincare products that have been opened or used. Please do not mail products back unless our team specifically instructs you to do so.

Questions About Your Order

We're here to help. If you have questions about a return, refund, damaged order, or your JIYU experience, contact us at: support@jiyuskin.com —we’re happy to make things right.

/pages/privacy-policy.html:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 5 January 2026

At JIYU Skincare (“JIYU,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), operated by Living Earth LLC, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share your information when you visit or make a purchase from our website.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you:

  • Create an account 

  • Make a purchase 

  • Sign up for our emails or promotions 

  • Contact us for support

This may include your name, email address, shipping/billing address, and payment details.
We also collect some automatic information, like cookies and analytics data, to help us understand how visitors use our site and improve your shopping experience.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process and fulfill orders
  • Provide shipping updates and customer support
  • Communicate with you (including transactional and marketing messages, where permitted)
  • Personalize your shopping experience
  • Improve our website, products, and services
  • Detect fraud and ensure security

3. How We Protect Your Information

We do not sell your personal data.

We may share your information with trusted third parties to operate our business, including:

  • E-commerce platform: Shopify
  • Payment processors: (e.g., Stripe, Shop Pay, PayPal)
  • Shipping & logistics providers
  • Analytics providers: (e.g., Google Analytics)
  • Marketing platforms: (e.g., email/SMS providers)

These parties are only given the information necessary to perform their services and are required to protect your data.

4. Your Rights

You can request to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. Just email us at support@jiyuskin.com and we’ll be happy to help.

5. Cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Enable website functionality
  • Analyze traffic and usage
  • Personalize content and marketing

You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Some features of the site may not function properly without cookies.

For users in certain regions, cookie consent may be requested upon visiting the site.

6. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, including:

  • Processing and fulfilling your orders
  • Providing customer support
  • Sending marketing communications (if you have opted in)
  • Complying with legal, tax, and accounting obligations

Order-related information is typically retained for several years to comply with financial and legal requirements. Marketing data (such as email engagement and preferences) is retained until you unsubscribe or request deletion.

When personal information is no longer required, we securely delete or anonymize it.

7. California Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA)

f you are a California resident, you have the right to:

  • Know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose
  • Request deletion of your personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate personal information
  • Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information

We do not sell personal information. However, certain data sharing for advertising or analytics purposes may be considered “sharing” under California law.

We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

To make a request, contact support@jiyuskin.com.

8. International Users (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, or other regions with similar data protection laws, you have certain rights under applicable regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

These rights may include:

  • The right to access the personal data we hold about you
  • The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
  • The right to request deletion of your personal data
  • The right to restrict or object to certain types of processing
  • The right to data portability
  • The right to withdraw consent at any time (for example, for marketing communications)

We process your personal data based on one or more of the following legal bases:

  • To fulfill a contract (e.g., processing and delivering your order)
  • To comply with legal obligations
  • Based on your consent (e.g., marketing communications)
  • For legitimate business interests (e.g., improving our services, fraud prevention, and analytics)

Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your jurisdiction, including the United States, where our service providers (such as Shopify, payment processors, and analytics platforms) operate. We take reasonable steps to ensure your data is protected in accordance with applicable laws.

To exercise your rights, please contact us at support@jiyuskin.com

9. Data Breach Notification

If we become aware of a data breach that affects your personal information, we will notify affected users and applicable authorities as required by law.

10. Children’s Privacy

Our website is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If such information is identified, we will delete it promptly.

11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised “Effective Date.”

12. Contact Us

For any privacy-related questions or requests, please contact:

Email: support@jiyuskin.com

Business: JIYU Skincare (operated by Living Earth LLC)

Questions?

Contact us anytime at support@jiyuskin.com

US Privacy Requests

If you reside in the United States, you may have specific rights regarding your personal information, including the right to access, delete, correct, and opt out of certain data uses. Use the options below to exercise your rights.

Note: Rights and availability depend on your state of residence and applicable law.


Access or download my data (Right to Know)

You can request a copy of the personal information we have collected about you, including account details and order history. We may need to verify your identity before providing access.

Response time: We respond to verifiable requests within 45 days. We may extend this by an additional 45 days where permitted by law (we will notify you if an extension is needed).


Correct my information

If you believe the personal information we maintain about you is inaccurate, you can request a correction here.


Delete my data

You can request the deletion of your personal information, subject to certain legal exceptions (for example, where retention is required for tax, security, or legal obligations).


Do Not Sell or Share

You can opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising (or "targeted advertising").

This opt-out is designed to be easy to use and does not require you to create an account.


Manage Your Privacy Choices Depending on your location, you may have the right to opt out of the sale of your personal info, withdraw consent for tracking, or customize your cookie preferences.


Authorized agents

You can authorize an agent to submit requests on your behalf. To do so, we may require signed permission from you and may ask you to verify your identity directly with us to confirm the agent's authority.

To submit an authorized agent request, please contact:

📧 support@jiyuskin.com


Right to appeal

If we deny your request, you may have the right to appeal our decision (depending on your state). To submit an appeal, please contact us with the subject line "Privacy Appeal."

Appeal contact: support@jiyuskin.com


Contact information

For questions about your privacy rights, please contact:

Email: support@jiyuskin.com

Address: 203 Saint Georges Drive, 63073 Saint Albans Missouri, United States

Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

If you are located in certain U.S. states (including California), you may have the right to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising (also called "targeted advertising").


Explanation

We may disclose certain information to third parties (such as advertising partners) to help measure performance and deliver relevant ads. Under some state privacy laws, these disclosures may be considered a "sale" or "sharing."


How to opt out

Global Privacy Control (GPC): If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal, we will treat it as an opt-out preference for this browser/device where supported.


Opt-out form: Submit the form below to record your opt-out preference for your customer account. We will apply your preference as soon as possible, though some systems may take time to fully update.

/pages/accessibility-statement.title: Accessibility Statement
/pages/accessibility-statement.html:
Accessibility Statement

Our commitment

JIYU wants everyone to be able to browse and buy on jiyuskin.com, including people who use screen readers, keyboard-only navigation, screen magnification, voice control, or other assistive technology. Accessibility is something we work on continuously, not a box we tick once.

Conformance status

We are working toward Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA. jiyuskin.com is currently partially conformant: most of the site meets the standard, and we have identified specific areas that do not yet. Those are listed below, and we are actively fixing them.

What we have done

  • Automated accessibility scanning of the storefront every night and on every code release, with findings tracked as scheduled work rather than ad-hoc fixes
  • A "skip to content" link and landmark structure so keyboard and screen-reader users can bypass the navigation
  • Visible keyboard focus indicators, so keyboard users can always see where they are
  • Text and background colour combinations checked against WCAG contrast minimums, measured on the rendered page rather than assumed from the palette
  • Alternative text on product and editorial imagery, with decorative images correctly hidden from screen readers
  • Correct heading structure so screen-reader users can navigate pages by heading
  • Real labels on every form field, including search and newsletter sign-up, and buttons that are announced by name rather than by icon
  • Carousels, sliders, and product galleries operable by keyboard, with named previous and next controls
  • Respect for the "Reduce Motion" setting in your device or browser — scrolling banners and auto-advancing carousels stop when it is enabled
  • Accessibility standards written into our development process, so new pages and features are built to them instead of retrofitted

Known limitations

We are aware of the following and are working to resolve them:

  • Third-party content. Some features on our site are provided by outside services — payment processing, customer reviews, subscriptions, rewards, chat, and marketing tools. We do not control their code and cannot guarantee their accessibility, but we raise issues with those vendors and replace tools that cannot meet the standard.
  • Video content. Some product and customer videos do not yet have captions or transcripts. Where a video carries information you need, contact us and we will provide it in text.

Tell us about a problem

If you hit a barrier anywhere on jiyuskin.com, we want to hear about it — it is the fastest way for us to find and fix real problems.

  • Email: accessibility@jiyuskin.com
  • Contact form: Contact us

Please tell us the page address, what you were trying to do, and what went wrong. If you use assistive technology, letting us know which one helps us reproduce the problem. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

If you cannot complete a purchase because of an accessibility barrier, contact us and we will help you place the order directly.

How we assess this site

We evaluate jiyuskin.com with three independent automated testing engines from Onbrand.Online, run nightly against the live store and again on every code release, backed by manual keyboard and screen-reader testing and color-contrast measurement against the rendered page. Automated tools cannot catch everything, which is why feedback from people using the site matters to us.

Technical information

jiyuskin.com relies on HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It is designed to work with current versions of major browsers and with assistive technology, and to remain usable when the browser text size is increased or the screen is magnified.

About this statement

This statement was prepared on 17 August 2026 and reflects the state of jiyuskin.com on that date. We review it as accessibility work is completed.
